title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Orzhov leader who takes the lead of the Agency's investigation after finding Teysa's body.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The murdered head of the Orzhov, whose body Kaya examines and whose ghost does not appear.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency who names Kaya head of the investigation.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae Agency investigator who becomes Kaya's partner.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos guild representative who receives Kaya and Kellan at Hellbender and sends them to Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A ghost and former top Boros investigator assigned to work alongside the Agency.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: The missing Dimir assassin whose escape from Azorius custody throws the Agency into turmoil.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective some suspect of helping Etrata disappear.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros leader who now directs the Legion's role in the investigation.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The murdered Simic guild leader.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Kellan's fae planeswalker father.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: The manor where Teysa's body lies.

entities.name: Agency headquarters
entities.description: The Agency's floating building, in turmoil.

entities.name: Hellbender
entities.description: A Rakdos nightclub in Plaza West.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The tree that shelters the original Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The founding pact of the guilds, whose original form Judith says Kaya must read.

entities.name: Phyrexian note
entities.description: The note in Phyrexian script Kaya found at the scene and pocketed.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild led by Teysa, whose ghosts recognize Kaya's authority.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild that seized the investigation and lost Etrata.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The enforcement guild that sends Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of violence and joy led by Judith.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Zegana's guild.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The unaffiliated investigators led by Ezrim.

events.summary: Kaya studies Teysa's body and the scene before the household arrives.
events.quote: Teysa's body had yet to cool.

events.summary: Kaya calls Teysa's spirit, but only a ghost servant answers that Teysa is not entertaining guests.
events.quote: Master Teysa is not entertaining guests at this time

events.summary: The ghost reveals Teysa dismissed the living servants in anticipation of Kaya's arrival.
events.quote: Master Teysa gave the living servants the day off, in anticipation of your arrival.

events.summary: The Orzhov dead pledge to tell investigators that this was not a power struggle with Kaya.
events.quote: We will tell the lawmages and investigators who are bound to come that this was not a power struggle between past and present leaders

events.summary: Kaya pockets the crumpled Phyrexian note instead of leaving it at the scene.
events.quote: Kaya scoffed, stuffing the crumpled Phyrexian note into her pocket.

events.summary: Kaya arrives at an Agency in uproar after the Azorius lost Etrata.
events.quote: The Agency headquarters were in chaos when Kaya arrived

events.summary: Ezrim rebukes his investigators over Etrata's disappearance.
events.quote: Etrata is still missing.

events.summary: Kaya pulls Kellan from an argument and he explains Etrata vanished from Azorius custody.
events.quote: Detective Proft went to speak with the prisoner in Azorius custody. When he got there, she was gone.

events.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim she now wants to lead the investigation.
events.quote: I would like to take point on this investigation.

events.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim that Teysa Karlov has been murdered.
events.quote: Teysa Karlov has been murdered.

events.summary: Kaya explains she cannot summon Teysa's ghost, who has warded her own soul.
events.quote: Teysa will appear when she wants to.

events.summary: Ezrim gives Kaya leadership of the investigation and tells her to begin with Judith.
events.quote: You returned before I could locate someone else to head the investigation. The position's yours.

events.summary: Ezrim assigns Kellan to accompany Kaya.
events.quote: Inspector Kellan, you'll accompany her.

events.summary: Kellan shows Kaya the evidence vault, including the containment capsule holding the Gruul god.
events.quote: That's where we're containing the Gruul god we detained

events.summary: Kaya senses a ghost entering the building.
events.quote: A ghost just entered the building.

events.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
events.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

events.summary: Kaya and Kellan head to Hellbender to find Judith.
events.quote: If we're going to speak with Judith, we need to head for Hellbender.

events.summary: Kaya intimidates the Rakdos doorman by letting him stab her intangible form.
events.quote: Can't stab what's not solid

events.summary: Judith makes a theatrical entrance on stage.
events.quote: Judith herself stepped around the curtain to center stage.

events.summary: Judith denies the murder, citing her verity circle and a dispute over interest rates with Teysa.
events.quote: I hardly think an argument over interest rates gives me cause to murder a Simic guildmaster

events.summary: Judith tells them to read the original Guildpact in Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: Go to Vitu-Ghazi. You need to read the Guildpact in its original form, and the tree shelters it.

events.summary: Kaya and Kellan leave as Judith looks smug.
events.quote: she looked smug, like everything was following her script once again.

relations.quote: According to Kellan, Oko was fey, making Kellan half-faerie.

relations.note: former top investigator, now a ghost
relations.quote: He was one of the Boros's best investigators when he was alive
now that Aurelia's running the show
We will solve this, and the Azorius will regret defaming us.

relations.note: admits a disagreement over interest rates
relations.quote: This is about my little disagreement with Teysa, then?
